metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in California higher than in Mississippi during July 12-19, 2005?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Was the land surface temperature in California higher than in Mississippi during July 12-19, 2005?" I need to: 1. Compare land surface temperature (LST) between two states during a specific week. 2. Use appropriate data source: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data would be best for 2005. 3. Time period: July 12-19, 2005. 4. Locations: California and Mississippi. 5. I should use MODIS/006/MOD11A2 which provides 8-day LST composites at 1km resolution. - Band: 'LST_Day_1km' for daytime temperature (in Kelvin) - Need to convert Kelvin to Celsius for interpretation: °C = K - 273.15 6. Need to handle quality control using the QC band. 7. Steps: - Define geometries for California and Mississippi - Filter MODIS collection by date - Mask poor quality pixels (using QC_Day band) - Compute mean LST for each state - Compare values 8. Potential issues: - Collection might be empty (C1) - After masking, no valid pixels (C2) - Calculation might fail (C3) - Valid comparison (A/B) Let me structure: 1. Define time range: July 12-19, 2005 (MODIS 8-day composites align with this) 2. Use MODIS/006/MOD11A2 collection 3. Get state boundaries from TIGER/2018/States 4. Mask using QC_Day: bits 0-1 = 00 (good quality) 5. Compute mean temperature in Celsius for each state 6. Compare and output result Important: Need to check for empty collections and no valid pixels. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var startDate = '2005-07-12'; var endDate = '2005-07-20'; // exclusive // Get state boundaries var states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States'); var california = states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'California')); var mississippi = states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Mississippi')); var californiaGeom = california.geometry(); var mississippiGeom = mississippi.geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Land Surface Temperature var modisLST = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); // Check if collection has data var collectionSize = modisLST.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS LST data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the single 8-day composite image var lstImage = modisLST.first(); // 3. Quality Masking // Extract QC band and create mask (bits 0-1: 00 = good quality) var qcDay = lstImage.select('QC_Day'); var mask = qcDay.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 = 00 // Apply mask and convert LST from Kelvin to Celsius var lstDay = lstImage.select('LST_Day_1km') .updateMask(mask) .multiply(0.02) // Scale factor for MODIS LST .subtract(273.15); // Convert K to °C // 4. Calculate mean LST for each state var californiaStats = lstDay.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: californiaGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var mississippiStats = lstDay.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mississippiGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Also count valid pixels to check for C2 var californiaCount = lstDay.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: californiaGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km'); var mississippiCount = lstDay.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mississippiGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km'); // Get values var caTemp = californiaStats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); var msTemp = mississippiStats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); var caCount = californiaCount.getInfo(); var msCount = mississippiCount.getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`California: ${caCount} valid pixels, Mean LST: ${caTemp !== null ? caTemp.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); console.log(`Mississippi: ${msCount} valid pixels, Mean LST: ${msTemp !== null ? msTemp.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); // Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (caCount === 0 || msCount === 0) { console.log("One or both states have no valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure (C3) if (caTemp === null || msTemp === null || isNaN(caTemp) || isNaN(msTemp) || caTemp < -100 || caTemp > 100 || // Valid LST range check msTemp < -100 || msTemp > 100) { console.log("Invalid temperature values calculated."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare temperatures if (caTemp > msTemp) { console.log(`California LST (${caTemp.toFixed(2)}°C) > Mississippi LST (${msTemp.toFixed(2)}°C)`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`California LST (${caTemp.toFixed(2)}°C) <= Mississippi LST (${msTemp.toFixed(2)}°C)`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
